brief:
Dozens of Israelis demonstrated outside the residence of a filmmaker associated with the documentary "NAZA," chanting "death to traitors," according to Al Jazeera English. The protest targeted the filmmaker's family home as part of what appeared to be a coordinated action.

The demonstration reflects ongoing tensions in Israel surrounding the film and its creators, though details about the specific grievances driving the protest remain limited.

title: Israeli protesters gather at filmmaker's home demanding death to traitors
